narrative.overview: A code-led Vietnamese operational interface centered on one attendance action, a prominent clock and readable records. Forest green, paper and white surfaces convey hierarchy without shadows. The Vietnamese login headline supplies identity while operational screens use familiar system text.

rules.name: Flat register
rules.body: Use tonal fields, fine borders and spacing rather than shadows.

rules.name: Explicit state
rules.body: Keep attendance and account-status labels alongside semantic colors.

dos: Do preserve Vietnamese labels and tabular times.
Do retain visible keyboard outlines and local overflow.
Do keep admin edits in their own destination.
donts: Don't add decorative raster imagery or fabricated evidence.
Don't describe unimplemented components as existing behavior.
